#![allow(unused, non_snake_case, non_camel_case_types, unreachable_patterns, unreachable_code, clippy::all)]

use super::types;

/// Error returned by procs.
pub type Error = Box<dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync>;

/// The node that failed, wrapping its implementation's error.
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct NodeError {
    pub node: &'static str,
    pub source: Error,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for NodeError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "{}: {}", self.node, self.source)
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for NodeError {
    fn source(&self) -> Option<&(dyn std::error::Error + 'static)> {
        Some(&*self.source)
    }
}

fn wrap(node: &'static str, source: Error) -> Error {
    Box::new(NodeError { node, source })
}

/// A failure as a program prints it: the error underneath the nodes, and
/// (when it passed through more than one) the nodes, outermost first.
pub fn describe_error(e: &Error) -> String {
    let mut nodes = vec![];
    let mut cur: &(dyn std::error::Error + Send + Sync + 'static) = &**e;
    while let Some(n) = cur.downcast_ref::<NodeError>() {
        nodes.push(n.node);
        cur = &*n.source;
    }
    if nodes.len() > 1 { format!("{cur}\n  (in {})", nodes.join(" > ")) } else { cur.to_string() }
}

fn get<'a, T>(slot: &'a Option<T>, node: &str) -> Result<&'a T, Error> {
    slot.as_ref().ok_or_else(|| format!("{node} has not run").into())
}

/// Moves a value out of its slot, at its last read.
fn take_slot<T>(slot: &mut Option<T>, node: &str) -> Result<T, Error> {
    slot.take().ok_or_else(|| format!("{node} has not run").into())
}

/// Looks up `k`, failing if it's missing.
fn map_get<K: Ord + std::fmt::Debug, V: Clone>(m: &std::collections::BTreeMap<K, V>, k: &K) -> Result<V, Error> {
    m.get(k).cloned().ok_or_else(|| format!("key {k:?} not found").into())
}

/// Indexes `xs`, failing if `i` is out of range.
fn slice_get<E: Clone>(xs: &[E], i: &i64) -> Result<E, Error> {
    usize::try_from(*i)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|i| xs.get(i).cloned())
        .ok_or_else(|| format!("index {i} out of range [0, {})", xs.len()).into())
}

/// Unoptimized, a proc's frame holds every node's temporaries at once, so
/// grammar-deep recursion overflows the default 2 MiB; debug builds give
/// their threads more.
fn thread_builder() -> std::thread::Builder {
    let b = std::thread::Builder::new();
    #[cfg(debug_assertions)]
    let b = b.stack_size(64 << 20);
    b
}

/// Runs `f` over `xs` on scoped threads; results keep input order.
fn fan_out<E: Send, R: Send>(xs: Vec<E>, f: impl Fn(E) -> Result<R, Error> + Sync) -> Result<Vec<R>, Error> {
    std::thread::scope(|s| {
        let f = &f;
        let handles: Vec<_> = xs
            .into_iter()
            .map(|x| thread_builder().spawn_scoped(s, move || f(x)).expect("cannot spawn a thread"))
            .collect();
        handles
            .into_iter()
            .map(|h| h.join().unwrap_or_else(|p| std::panic::resume_unwind(p)))
            .collect()
    })
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
struct EnvMerge {
    in_merge_merge: Option<InMergeMerge>,
    out_merge_merge: Option<types::MergeMergeOut>,
    in_merge_d: Option<InMergeD>,
    out_merge_d: Option<i64>,
    in_merge_g: Option<InMergeG>,
    out_merge_g: Option<i64>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum PcMerge {
    MergeMerge,
    MergeD,
    MergeG,
}

/// Runs proc Merge.
pub fn run_merge(e: types::E) -> Result<i64, Error> {
    let mut env = EnvMerge::default();
    env.in_merge_merge = Some(InMergeMerge { e: e });
    let mut pc = PcMerge::MergeMerge;
    loop {
        match pc {
            PcMerge::MergeMerge => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_merge_merge, "Merge.Merge")?;
                let this = types::MergeMergeOut { e: input.e };
                if (matches!((&(&this).e), types::E::A(..))) {
                    let b_x = (match (&(&this).e) { types::E::A(p) => p, _ => unreachable!() }).clone();
                    env.in_merge_d = Some(InMergeD { value: b_x });
                    pc = PcMerge::MergeD;
                    continue;
                }
                if (matches!((&(&this).e), types::E::B(..))) {
                    let b_x = (match (&(&this).e) { types::E::B(p) => p, _ => unreachable!() }).clone();
                    env.in_merge_d = Some(InMergeD { value: (b_x + 1_i64) });
                    pc = PcMerge::MergeD;
                    continue;
                }
                return Err(format!("Merge.Merge: no match arm for {:?}", this).into());
            }
            PcMerge::MergeD => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_merge_d, "Merge.D")?;
                let this = input.value;
                env.in_merge_g = Some(InMergeG { x: this });
                pc = PcMerge::MergeG;
                continue;
            }
            PcMerge::MergeG => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_merge_g, "Merge.G")?;
                let this = unimplemented_merge_g(input.x).map_err(|e| wrap("Merge.G", e.into()))?;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            _ => return Err(format!("Merge: invalid state {pc:?}").into()),
        }
    }
}

// ---- proc Sum ----

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]
struct EnvSum {
    in_sum_sum: Option<InSumSum>,
    out_sum_sum: Option<types::SumSumOut>,
    in_sum_l: Option<InSumL>,
    out_sum_l: Option<types::SumLOut>,
    in_sum_id1: Option<InSumId1>,
    out_sum_id1: Option<i64>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
enum PcSum {
    SumSum,
    SumL,
    SumId1,
}

/// Runs proc Sum.
pub fn run_sum(xs: types::List<i64>) -> Result<i64, Error> {
    let mut env = EnvSum::default();
    env.in_sum_sum = Some(InSumSum { xs: xs });
    let mut pc = PcSum::SumSum;
    loop {
        match pc {
            PcSum::SumSum => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_sum_sum, "Sum.Sum")?;
                let this = types::SumSumOut { xs: input.xs };
                env.out_sum_sum = Some(this.clone());
                env.in_sum_l = Some(InSumL { value: types::SumLOut { i: 0_i64, acc: 0_i64 } });
                pc = PcSum::SumL;
                continue;
            }
            PcSum::SumL => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_sum_l, "Sum.L")?;
                let this = input.value;
                env.out_sum_l = Some(this.clone());
                if (get(&env.out_sum_l, "Sum.L")?.i.clone() == ((get(&env.out_sum_sum, "Sum.Sum")?.xs.clone()).len() as i64)) {
                    let slot_sum_l = take_slot(&mut env.out_sum_l, "Sum.L")?;
                    env.in_sum_id1 = Some(InSumId1 { value: slot_sum_l.acc });
                    pc = PcSum::SumId1;
                    continue;
                }
                let slot_sum_l = take_slot(&mut env.out_sum_l, "Sum.L")?;
                env.in_sum_l = Some(InSumL { value: types::SumLOut { i: (slot_sum_l.i.clone() + 1_i64), acc: (slot_sum_l.acc + slice_get(&get(&env.out_sum_sum, "Sum.Sum")?.xs.clone(), &slot_sum_l.i).map_err(|e| wrap("Sum", e))?) } });
                pc = PcSum::SumL;
                continue;
            }
            PcSum::SumId1 => {
                let input = take_slot(&mut env.in_sum_id1, "Sum.id1")?;
                let this = input.value;
                return Ok(this);
            }
            _ => return Err(format!("Sum: invalid state {pc:?}").into()),
        }
    }
}

/// Stands in for Merge.G, which names no .rs implementation. Write
/// `pub fn name(x: i64) -> Result<i64, E>`
/// and add `= "file.rs:name"` to its declaration.
fn unimplemented_merge_g(_: i64) -> Result<i64, Error> {
    Err("Merge.G is not implemented".into())
}

#![allow(non_camel_case_types, non_snake_case, dead_code)]

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::sync::Arc;

/// A string. Immutable, so a clone shares it.
pub type Str = Arc<str>;

/// An array. Immutable, so a clone shares it. `concat` reuses this one's
/// buffer when nothing else shares it, and copies otherwise. Derefs to a
/// slice.
#[derive(PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]
pub struct List<T>(Arc<Vec<T>>);

impl<T> Clone for List<T> {
    fn clone(&self) -> Self {
        List(self.0.clone())
    }
}

impl<T> Default for List<T> {
    fn default() -> Self {
        List(Arc::new(Vec::new()))
    }
}

impl<T> std::ops::Deref for List<T> {
    type Target = [T];
    fn deref(&self) -> &[T] {
        &self.0
    }
}

impl<T> From<Vec<T>> for List<T> {
    fn from(v: Vec<T>) -> Self {
        List(Arc::new(v))
    }
}

impl<T: Clone> From<&[T]> for List<T> {
    fn from(v: &[T]) -> Self {
        List(Arc::new(v.to_vec()))
    }
}

impl<T> FromIterator<T> for List<T> {
    fn from_iter<I: IntoIterator<Item = T>>(iter: I) -> Self {
        List(Arc::new(iter.into_iter().collect()))
    }
}

impl<T: Clone> IntoIterator for List<T> {
    type Item = T;
    type IntoIter = std::vec::IntoIter<T>;
    fn into_iter(self) -> Self::IntoIter {
        Arc::unwrap_or_clone(self.0).into_iter()
    }
}

impl<'a, T> IntoIterator for &'a List<T> {
    type Item = &'a T;
    type IntoIter = std::slice::Iter<'a, T>;
    fn into_iter(self) -> Self::IntoIter {
        self.0.iter()
    }
}

impl<T: std::fmt::Debug> std::fmt::Debug for List<T> {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        f.debug_list().entries(self.iter()).finish()
    }
}

impl<T: Clone> List<T> {
    /// This array's elements, then `other`'s. Appends in place when nothing
    /// else shares this array.
    pub fn concat(mut self, other: &List<T>) -> List<T> {
        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).extend_from_slice(other);
        self
    }
}

/// A map. Immutable, so a clone shares it. `merge` and `without` change
/// this one in place when nothing else shares it, and copy otherwise.
/// Derefs to a `BTreeMap`.
#[derive(PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]
pub struct Map<K, V>(Arc<BTreeMap<K, V>>);

impl<K, V> Clone for Map<K, V> {
    fn clone(&self) -> Self {
        Map(self.0.clone())
    }
}

impl<K, V> Default for Map<K, V> {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Map(Arc::new(BTreeMap::new()))
    }
}

impl<K, V> std::ops::Deref for Map<K, V> {
    type Target = BTreeMap<K, V>;
    fn deref(&self) -> &BTreeMap<K, V> {
        &self.0
    }
}

impl<K, V> From<BTreeMap<K, V>> for Map<K, V> {
    fn from(m: BTreeMap<K, V>) -> Self {
        Map(Arc::new(m))
    }
}

impl<K: Ord, V> FromIterator<(K, V)> for Map<K, V> {
    fn from_iter<I: IntoIterator<Item = (K, V)>>(iter: I) -> Self {
        Map(Arc::new(iter.into_iter().collect()))
    }
}

impl<K: Clone, V: Clone> IntoIterator for Map<K, V> {
    type Item = (K, V);
    type IntoIter = std::collections::btree_map::IntoIter<K, V>;
    fn into_iter(self) -> Self::IntoIter {
        Arc::unwrap_or_clone(self.0).into_iter()
    }
}

impl<K: std::fmt::Debug, V: std::fmt::Debug> std::fmt::Debug for Map<K, V> {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        self.0.fmt(f)
    }
}

impl<K: Ord + Clone, V: Clone> Map<K, V> {
    /// This map's entries and `other`'s; `other` wins.
    pub fn merge(mut self, other: &Map<K, V>) -> Map<K, V> {
        Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0).extend(other.iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), v.clone())));
        self
    }

    /// This map without `keys`.
    pub fn without(mut self, keys: &[K]) -> Map<K, V> {
        if keys.iter().any(|k| self.0.contains_key(k)) {
            let m = Arc::make_mut(&mut self.0);
            for k in keys {
                m.remove(k);
            }
        }
        self
    }
}
